correctness.rationale: All quantifiers are settled analytically. Reality, nonnegativity and nonzero Fourier zero modes force support parity. Tao's prime-order theorem yields the sharp necessary sum bound. For k<=ell, write p=2m+1, k=2r+1, ell=p-2s with s<=r<=m-s. The s smallest distinct cosine grid values are strictly negative since s<=m/2. Hence all r Laurent factors have positive coefficients; the Laurent expansion is strictly positive at every degree -r..r. The same polynomial is nonnegative on the p-point cosine grid and has exactly s zero opposite-pairs. Fourier involution gives the swapped cases. The boundary cases s=0 and r=0 are included. The 502 checks for 10 small primes are confirmations and not used as proof.

originality.rationale: The complete spatial/Fourier cardinality feasibility diagram for simultaneously nonnegative and positive-definite signals is not supplied by the checked prior statements. Tao proves the lower bound and unconstrained complex feasibility, but not sign-preserving feasibility. Positive-definite Turán analyses optimize function mass/coefficients on fixed sets; the more recent finite-group bounds constrain values, without producing every possible positive support pair. Actual semantic searches of closely related public mathematical claims gave no equivalent pair theorem. Remaining risk is an unlocated equivalent in classical nonnegative trigonometric-polynomial theory.
residual_risks: An older positivity-preserving polynomial interpolation argument could imply the same classification under a different name and may not be indexed.
Source inspections targeted the materially relevant statements/sections, not an exhaustive history of all trigonometric polynomial literature.

value.rationale: The class of nonnegative positive-definite cyclic kernels is natural in finite harmonic-analysis extremal optimization. The standard prime uncertainty inequality does not determine whether every cardinality pair has a feasible point in this smaller cone. A complete all-odd-prime iff diagram together with exact strictly-positive witness products settles that real feasibility gap and eliminates possible hidden sparsity obstructions; this is structural, not a table recomputation.
